theme: 3 terms for adaptive SwiftUI layouts: who gets space first, the first child that fits and switching layouts

terms.definition: A number that tells a stack which view gets space first when there is not enough room.
terms.example: Give the title a higher Layout Priority.

terms.definition: A container that shows the first of its children that fits in the space it has.
terms.example: Use ViewThatFits, so small phones get the short version.

terms.definition: A type that wraps any layout, so you can switch between layouts and still animate.
terms.example: Wrap both versions in AnyLayout to animate the change.

video.title: Layout Priority, ViewThatFits & AnyLayout | Day 155
video.description:
Learn to explain how to adapt a SwiftUI layout to small screens: Layout Priority, ViewThatFits & AnyLayout, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Layout Priority - A number that tells a stack which view gets space first when there is not enough room.
ViewThatFits - A container that shows the first of its children that fits in the space it has.
AnyLayout - A type that wraps any layout, so you can switch between layouts and still animate.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 155 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

Explain Layout Priority, ViewThatFits & AnyLayout in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
레이아웃 프라이오리티, 뷰댓핏츠, 애니레이아웃 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Layout Priority - A number that tells a stack which view gets space first when there is not enough room.
한국어: 레이아웃 프라이오리티: 공간이 부족할 때 스택이 어떤 뷰에게 먼저 공간을 줄지 알려 주는 숫자

ViewThatFits - A container that shows the first of its children that fits in the space it has.
한국어: 뷰댓핏츠: 자식 뷰 중에서 가진 공간에 맞는 첫 번째 뷰를 보여 주는 컨테이너

AnyLayout - A type that wraps any layout, so you can switch between layouts and still animate.
한국어: 애니레이아웃: 어떤 레이아웃이든 감싸서, 레이아웃을 바꾸면서도 애니메이션을 줄 수 있게 하는 타입

landscape.hook: Can you explain Layout Priority, ViewThatFits and AnyLayout in English?

dialogue.title: The cut-off title

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, on small phones my title is cut off next to the New badge.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give the title a higher Layout Priority. The stack gives it space first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wrote `.layoutPriority(1)`, and the title is complete now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Without a Layout Priority, both views fight for the same space.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But on the smallest phone it still does not fit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then put two versions in a ViewThatFits. It shows the first child that fits.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the horizontal one first, and the vertical one second?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The ViewThatFits checks them in that order.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I switch between them with an animation?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wrap each layout in AnyLayout. You can change the layout and still animate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I already have both in the code. Is AnyLayout slow?
Give the title a higher Layout Priority.
